Narrow by design: run_check satisfiability only. No general per-tool registry, and no artifact claims one.
hasSatisfiableCommandCwd() calls resolveCommandCwd itself, so satisfiability and enforcement cannot drift. No second predicate.

resolveCommandCwd gained a directory assertion ('Command cwd is not a directory'). It previously accepted a declared FILE as a cwd, failing later as an opaque spawn error. This is a real behaviour change to execution, failing closed earlier, and is what makes reusing the same call a correct satisfiability test.
narrowUnsatisfiableCapabilities() runs last in validateConfiguration as a broker-creation-time snapshot; later filesystem drift can only fail closed, never widen exposure.
Every exposure surface agrees: definitions, describeCapabilities().tools, and commandPrefixes, asserted together in one regression.
